newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended April 30 fell to $943.30 billion from a revised $964.24 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 663 retail money market mutual funds fell $11.82 billion to $634.40 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 402 taxable money market funds fell $7.70 billion to $523.14 billion, while assets of the 261 tax-exempt funds fell $4.12 billion to $111.26 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 323 institutional money market funds fell $9.12 billion to $308.90 billion. Of these, assets of the 260 taxable money market funds decreased $9.42 billion to $277.99 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds rose $303.2 million to $30.91 billion, it said.
ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $964.24 billion from $964.26 billion.
